h: How central banks set interest rates
s: Banks raise rates to cool prices and cut them to spur growth. It works with a delay, often 6 to 18 months.
tl: High inflation forces aggressive rate hikes
Rates cut near zero after the financial crisis
Fastest hikes in decades to fight inflation
w: Understanding the cycle makes rate headlines easier to judge.

h: Why climate summits keep returning to money
s: Poorer nations bear much of the damage but emitted far less. Finance - who pays, how much - is the recurring sticking point.
tl: First global climate treaty is adopted
$100bn a year promised, reached years late
Talks shift to damage and resilience funds
w: Explains why funding deals matter even before the numbers.

h: How a bill becomes law in India
s: A bill is introduced in either House, debated, sent to committees if needed, passed by both Houses, then approved by the President.
tl: Passed by both Houses, then Presidential assent
w: Helps you follow where new policies actually stand.
